title: Unit – 5 : Session – 12 : SLO – 1  |  ARM Addressing and Instruction Encoding
sections: I. Multiple Choice
1. B) LDR R0, =0x40 — the literal-pool pseudo-instruction loads a constant.
2. B) Post-indexed — the base register is updated after the memory access.
3. C) Opcode + operands + condition — encoding covers all three fields.
II. Fill in the Blanks
1. before — pre-indexed addressing updates the base register before access.
2. LDR — literal constants are loaded with LDR Rd, =constant.
3. shift — scaled register offset applies a shift (e.g. LSL) to the index register.
III. True or False
1. TRUE.
2. FALSE — encoding identifies opcode, operands and condition fields, not just the opcode.
3. TRUE.
IV. Match the Following
A) LDR — 3) Load data from memory.
B) STR — 1) Store register to memory.
C) Pre-indexed — 4) Base updated before access.
D) Literal LDR — 2) Load from constant pool.
V. Numerical Answers
3. 0xE2821005 → cond=1110, I=1 (immediate), opcode=0101 (ADC), S=0, Rn=R2, Rd=R1, operand2=#5 → ADC R1, R2, #5.
